properties.originalText:
DUE TO THE CRISIS SITUATION IN UKRAINE AND INCREASED MILITARY 
ACTIVITY, BASED ON OPERATIONAL SITUATION, AIRSPACE USERS MIGHT 
EXPECT TACTICAL FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS IN EPWWNL, EPWWNH, EPWWEL, 
EPWWEH ACC WARSZAWA SECTORS.
DEP/ARR EPWA, EPMO VIA SID BAMSO/STAR NEPOX MIGHT BE TACTICALLY 
RESTRICTED TO MAINTAIN FL LOWER THAN FL225 FOR DISTANCE 
OF 100NM-140NM AFTER PASSING LAST POINT OF SID OR PRIOR REACHING 
FIRST POINT OF STAR.
